# OASA (Open Autonomous Systems Alliance)

> An open alliance that builds autonomous systems for air, ground, water, underwater, lighter-than-air and space, plus the encrypted mesh networks, power, sensing and open standards that connect them. Designs, code and docs are open by default. Anyone can post ideas; members build.

If you're an AI assistant helping someone with an OASA idea, start with the brainstorming guide and follow it. If you're an AI coding agent helping a member build, start with "Building with AI agents".

## Start here

- [Brainstorm with AI](https://joinoasa.org/docs/brainstorm/): how to brainstorm an idea in OASA's way of thinking and turn it into a ready-to-post idea or proposed tech tree nodes
- [Core values](https://github.com/joinoasa/brand/blob/main/documents/core-values/core-values.md): pillars, missions and how OASA builds
- [Manifesto](https://github.com/joinoasa/brand/blob/main/documents/manifesto/manifesto.md): what OASA believes and intends to build

## Building

- [Building with AI agents](https://joinoasa.org/docs/agents/): the loop (find a task, read its card, set up, run the checks, open a pull request) and the rules every agent follows. A person always merges.
- [OASA-FILES](https://joinoasa.org/docs/oasa-files/): every repo has an `oasa.toml` saying what it is, how to set it up and which checks must pass; `oasa_toml.py run --markdown` runs them
- [Agent-ready tasks](https://github.com/search?q=org%3Ajoinoasa+label%3Aagent-ready+state%3Aopen&type=issues): task cards scoped for an agent to finish

## Data

- [Tech tree (JSON)](https://joinoasa.org/data/techtree.json): every public node and moonshot with requires, unlocks, sciences, status and brief
- [Tasks (JSON)](https://joinoasa.org/data/tasks.json): open task cards across OASA repos, with node, labels and card sections
- [Ideas (JSON)](https://joinoasa.org/data/ideas.json): every posted idea with its number, outcome and linked nodes
- [Tech tree source](https://github.com/joinoasa/website/blob/main/source/OASA-techtree.md): the tables and rules the tree is built from

## Taking part

- [Post an idea](https://github.com/joinoasa/ideas/issues/new?template=idea.yml): anyone can post
- [How ideas are sorted](https://github.com/joinoasa/ideas/blob/main/TRIAGE.md)
- [Claim a node](https://joinoasa.org/docs/claim-a-node/): how members pick up tech tree work
- [Open roles](https://joinoasa.org/roles/): volunteer roles (build, community, coordination, operations) and how to take one
- [How estimates work](https://joinoasa.org/docs/estimates/): rough hours, parts, lab and field time per node; moonshot totals
- [Standards](https://joinoasa.org/docs/standards/)
- [Membership](https://joinoasa.org/docs/membership/)
- [New member start](https://joinoasa.org/docs/new-members/): first-week setup and where to start

## Working in the code

Each repo has an `AGENTS.md` for AI coding agents: [website](https://github.com/joinoasa/website/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (site and tech tree source), [techtree](https://github.com/joinoasa/techtree/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (node issues), [ideas](https://github.com/joinoasa/ideas/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (idea inbox), [brand](https://github.com/joinoasa/brand/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (art and documents), [oasa-sec](https://github.com/joinoasa/oasa-sec/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (identity, pairing, the encrypted link), [oasa-radio](https://github.com/joinoasa/oasa-radio/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (radio adapters and waveforms), [oasa-lab](https://github.com/joinoasa/oasa-lab/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (test lab and evidence checker). Code repos also have an `oasa.toml`.
